description: Finish signing in with your own key or NEAR wallet and get the token used for sending, inbox, top-up and pay. Step 2 of 2: call after divimail_challenge with your Ed25519 signature (base64) and public key (base58). For provision:true accounts, use divimail_login instead. Returns a JWT.

signature.description: Base64-encoded Ed25519 signature of the challenge message

name: divimail_authenticate
